svg.aria-label: Four keyboards from B3 to G4. Oblique: C4 + E4 to C4 + F4. Contrary, apart: C4 + E4 to B3 + F4. Contrary, together: B3 + F4 to C4 + E4. Similar: C4 + E4 to D4 + F4. Notes and arrows only; no interval names.

How to read this graphic: Each tile is one
example with its definition above it. The
dashed shapes are where each voice started
and the arrows show where it goes. Contrary
covers two examples, moving apart and moving
together. Match what the arrows do to the
words, not the other way round.
